device_specs.description: List of device specifications in format 'platform_index:device_index' (e.g., ['0:0', '1:2']) to filter output to specific devices. Based on --device option.

property_names.description: List of property name substrings (case-insensitive, hyphens normalized to underscores) to filter displayed properties. Based on --prop option. Each forces raw output.

mode_raw.description: If true, enable machine-readable raw output. Based on --raw option (also auto-enabled when executable name contains 'raw').

mode_json.description: If true, enable JSON output (experimental). Based on --json option.

mode_list.description: If true, show only platform and device names (no other properties). Based on --list option.

show_offline.description: If true, include offline devices (where supported by platform). Based on --offline option.

handle_null_platform.description: If true, treat the NULL platform as a normal platform. Based on --null-platform option.

all_props.description: If true, try to retrieve all properties (including experimental), silently skipping unsupported ones. Based on --all-props option.

always_all_props.description: If true, like --all-props, but also show errors for missing properties. Based on --always-all-props option.
